jobs.title: Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States of America
jobs.description: In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. This is a Software Engineering position at the Director level, which is part of the job family responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions that support business needs. Morgan Stanley is an industry leader in financial services, known for mobilizing capital to help governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals around the world achieve their financial goals. Interested in joining a team that’s eager to create, innovate and make an impact on the world? Read on. Build real systems. Own real problems. Ship at scale. We are looking for a strong backend engineer with around 4+ years of hands-on experience building and operating production-grade services. This role is for engineers who enjoy thinking through ambiguity, designing clean abstractions, and understanding how systems behave under load, failure, and change. If you like solving real engineering problems, not toy puzzles, and want to work close to distributed systems, APIs, data, and platform concerns, this role is for you. What you’ll do in the role: Designing and building new backend services and APIs from scratch Working on distributed systems with real scalability, latency, and reliability constraints Making thoughtful trade-offs across performance, consistency, and complexity Writing clean, maintainable, and testable code that others enjoy working with Owning services end-to-end: design - build - deploy - operate Debugging production issues and improving system resilience over time Core Engineering Skills Strong proficiency in Java and Python as primary languages for backend engineering Solid understanding of HTTP fundamentals Strong grasp of object-oriented design, clean class modeling, and design patterns with multi-threaded and event-driven systems Awareness of me Good command of data structures and collections, and when to use them Hands-on experience with multi-thread and event-driven systems. Awareness of memory usage, time and space complexity Framework & Platform Knowledge Experience with dependency injection and lifecycle management Understanding of AOP concepts (advice, pointcuts, cross-cutting concerns) Experience with transaction management Familiarity with connection pools and resource management System Design & Distributed Systems Exposure Experience designing read and write APIs focused on stability, scalability, and performance Exposure to real-world event-driven systems, pub-sub patterns, and fault tolerance Familiarity with caching strategies (local and distributed) Practical understanding of batch processing and data pipelines is a plus Practical understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability Working knowledge of security fundamentals (authentication, authorization, encryption) How You Work You are comfortable thinking out loud and reasoning through problems You do not need perfectly defined requirements to get started You focus on clarity, correctness, and simplicity You can explain why you made a design choice, not just what you built You take ownership and follow problems through to resolution What You Can Expect From the Interview Process Hands-on, real-world problem discussions No tell me about yourself or resume walkthroughs Focus on how you think, design, and reason Interactive conversations, not trivia or puzzle solving Why Join Us Work on meaningful systems with real impact Engineering culture that values depth over buzzwords Opportunity to grow into system design and ownership roles Smart peers, real problems, and room to think What you’ll bring to the role: Strong proficiency in Java and Python for backend application development. Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Design, Design Patterns, and data structures. 4+ years of relevant experience. Experience building scalable REST APIs and distributed systems. Hands-on experience with multi-threaded and event-driven systems. Experience with messaging/pub-sub systems and event-driven architectures. Exposure to batch processing and data pipeline technologies. Knowledge of Spring Framework, dependency injection, AOP, and transaction management. Familiarity with databases, caching, connection pooling, and resource management. Understanding of security fundamentals, logging, monitoring, and observability. Experience with unit testing, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Comfortable working in globally distributed teams and collaborating with business stakeholders. Nice to Have: Experience with BDD testing frameworks and tools. Work in an open environment where everyone can express their views and make significant contributions. Comfortable working in globally distributed teams and collaborating with business stakeholders. Nice to Have: Experience with BDD testing frameworks and tools. Working an open environment where everyone can express their views and make significant contributions. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY: At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices​ into your browser. Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $120,000 and $170,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs. Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents. Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences. For more information, please visit : https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo .

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Amazon Leo Optical Inter-Satellite Link
jobs.description: Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth’s most customer centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join this ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in distributed systems and software design. Come work at Amazon! Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities * Design, develop, and optimize highly reliable flight software for optical inter-satellite link systems, spanning low-level device drivers and real-time control loops to high-level autonomous behaviors, fault management, and AI/ML-driven decision-making that target RTOS and bare-metal environments * Architect and implement fault-tolerant, redundant software systems that keep optical links alive across a constellation of satellites, including health monitoring and autonomous recovery without ground intervention * Build and maintain robust test, validation, and simulation infrastructure, from hardware-in-the-loop testbeds and software-in-the-loop virtualizations to automated regression suites * Own the full lifecycle of embedded software delivery - from requirements decomposition and architecture design through implementation, code review, integration, deployment, and long-term maintenance of software running on satellites in orbit * Collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams spanning hardware, optics, systems, communications, and operations engineers to design, integrate, test, and deploy high-speed optical communication systems that push the boundaries of space-based networking * Develop and refine autonomous operational behaviors that enable satellites to independently acquire, track, and maintain optical links, adapt to changing constellation geometries, and respond to anomalies * Drive continuous improvement of deployment and over-the-air (OTA) update processes, ensuring new capabilities and fixes can be safely and reliably delivered to hundreds of satellites on orbit with minimal operational risk A day in the life As a Software Engineer on the Optical Inter-Satellite Link team, you won't just write code - you'll see it fly. Your software will control and monitor high-speed laser communications between satellites moving at orbital velocities, and you'll be there for every stage of the journey: from early design and on-the-ground verifications to watching your code commission an optical link for the first time in orbit. About the team We are looking for a software engineer who combines deep technical and analytical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right things done quickly and effectively, and someone who thrives at the intersection of hardware and software, space and ground, autonomy and operations. You will join a multi-disciplinary team of top-notch engineers whose work spans an unusually wide aperture: embedded flight software running on satellites in orbit, cloud-based systems powering mission and network operations, automation frameworks that keep a growing constellation healthy, and AI-driven capabilities that make our optical links smarter with every orbit. We collaborate closely with optical, electrical, firmware, opto-mechanical, and operations teams — and with partner organizations including Mission Operations and Optical Network Operations — to deliver one of the most advanced optical communication systems ever built. - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Experience with Linux-based development environments, cross-compilation toolchains, and hardware-in-the-loop or software-in-the-loop test frameworks - Experience in Rust, C and/or C++ with strong understanding of memory management, concurrency, and deterministic execution. - Experience with Python for test automation, simulation, or tooling in support of embedded development workflows. - Experience developing embedded software for space systems - Familiarity with optical communication systems, laser terminals, or high-speed serial interfaces - Experience with FPGA-adjacent software development, including register-level interfaces, DMA engines, or hardware/software co-design Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . USA, CA, NORTHRIDGE - 143,700.00 - 194,400.00 USD annually USA, WA, Redmond - 143,700.00 - 194,400.00 USD annually
